rule: Choose skills by reasoning operations and evidence requirements, never by a closed list of course names. Unknown operations are allowed and must be documented as capability gaps.

packs.quality_gate: Each conclusion follows from named premises; no hidden division by zero or missing edge cases.
No legal claim without precise relevant authority and effective-date review.
Never issue clinical-ready materials without verified current medical sources and qualified review.
Run tests on all claimed executable code; distinguish implementation failure from methodological failure.
No unsupported causal inferences or invented statistics.
All numerical scenarios checked with independent reference values.
No fabricated author intent, quotation, historical claims or empirical evidence.
Each claimed competency matches an actually demanded performance.
No redundant cards, generic explanations or untested Anki-client claims.

methods: valid model boundaries and reference fixtures
explain why no lab when unnecessary
packs.quality_gate: All provided controls produce validated, finite outputs; no fake simulation.
